text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page triggered for service=model-serving-prod-eu-west-1
metrics: 95th latency > 1200ms (8 events in 2m). Auto-escalate in 5m if not acked. https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-8347

mike: ack'd — I'm on it. grabbing logs.

mike: quick look — brief spike in router latency, a few 503s from proxy but error rate still low. checking autoscaler and cache.

alisha: saw fallback hits to smaller model variants and a KV-cache prefill job starting around 10:23 UTC. might be warmup churn.

mike: can you grep router logs for "prefetch"? paste snippet if you see correlation.

alisha: running:
```
kubectl logs router-1 -n prod | grep prefetch | tail -n 30
```

alisha: found prefetch bursts at 10:23:12, 10:23:45 aligning with pager spikes; job finished by 10:25:10. cache miss ratio spiked to 18% briefly.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page auto-resolved — all monitored metrics back to normal :white_check_mark: (no open alerts)

mike: :thumbsup: no customer-facing errors observed in the last 30m. marking as transient.

alisha: I'll open a follow-up to throttle the prefill job and relax that canary alert threshold. assigning to @alisha for the PR and runbook update.

mike: please add a runbook note on prefill-induced latency and a suggested cool-down. set severity to P3 and close once PR merges.

pagerduty: Incident record created: INC-2026-8347 (link) — auto-resolved, no escalation performed.

alisha: will post PR link here. closing thread once changes land.

mike: thanks — nice quick reconcile.
